delete.summary: Owners can remove anyone; any member can leave.

put.summary:
Replace the whole map: features with a known ``id`` are updated, those without are
created, and existing features missing from the payload are deleted.

parameters.name: open
parameters.description: true: only todo/doing; false: only done

parameters.name: due_by
parameters.description: Due on or before this date (includes overdue)

post.summary: Mark done. A recurring task spawns its next occurrence.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Day to plan for; defaults to today (server date)

get.summary: Everything open that is due on or before ``date`` (so overdue jobs are included).

post.summary: Upload a photo or video. Time, GPS, size and thumbnail are read in the background.
Queue processing again, e.g. after a failure or if the broker was down at upload.

get.summary: The file or its thumbnail. Authorised by the signed ``t`` token from the media JSON.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Length of the daily history window, ending today (UTC)

parameters.name: today
parameters.description: Treat this as today (UTC); mainly for tests

get.summary: Per-day activity counts, weekly comparison, streaks and the newest photos.

tags.name: tasks
tags.description: Tasks, optionally pinned to the map

tags.name: overview
tags.description: Progress overview: what got done, and when

spawned_task_id.description: Set when completing a recurring task

features.description: The whole map, for the sketch

url.description: Signed, short-lived link to the file

current.description: Consecutive active days up to today or yesterday

recent_done.description: Latest completed tasks: id, title, completed_at
